summary.zh: 转动模型，观察一个碳周围的空间方向。
summary.en: Rotate each model to inspect the arrangement around a carbon atom.

tips.zh: 109.5°、120°、180°是局部几何的理想参考值，不是所有分子的所有键角。
tips.en: 109.5°, 120° and 180° describe ideal local geometries, not every angle in every molecule.

tips.zh: 双键或三键，在判断空间方向时各算一个方向。
tips.en: A double or triple bond counts as one bonding direction when identifying local geometry.

summary.zh: 主链有几个碳，与整个分子有几个碳，是两个问题。
summary.en: Parent-chain length and total carbon count are different quantities.

tips.zh: 比较编号时，比较第一个不同的位置，不比较编号总和。
tips.en: Compare locants at the first point of difference, not the sum of locants.

tips.zh: 简单烷基支链按英文名称字母序排列，不按支链大小；di、tri不参与字母序。
tips.en: Order simple alkyl substituents by alphabetical order, not branch size; ignore di and tri in that ordering.

tips.zh: 无环饱和烷烃通式CnH2n+2；n是整个分子的碳数。
tips.en: For acyclic saturated alkanes, the formula is CnH2n+2; n counts all carbon atoms.

summary.zh: 多重键决定词尾和编号方向，环结构用cyclo。
summary.en: Multiple bonds determine suffixes and numbering; rings use cyclo.

tips.zh: 烯和炔是不饱和烃；无环单烯CnH2n、无环单炔CnH2n−2有各自适用范围。
tips.en: Alkenes and alkynes are unsaturated. CnH2n and CnH2n−2 apply to acyclic monoalkenes and monoalkynes respectively.

tips.zh: 简单单环环烷烃也满足CnH2n，不能只靠分子式把它与烯区分。
tips.en: Simple monocyclic cycloalkanes also have formula CnH2n; formula alone does not distinguish them from alkenes.

tips.zh: 二维多边形表示连接关系；环己烷不是平面正六边形，也不是苯。
tips.en: A 2D polygon shows connectivity. Cyclohexane is neither a flat regular hexagon nor benzene.

summary.zh: 切换位置异构体，对照邻、间、对与编号。
summary.en: Compare positional isomers: ortho, meta and para.

tips.zh: 邻位1,2；间位1,3；对位1,4。两个相同取代基的1,5位可改编为1,3。
tips.en: Ortho is 1,2; meta is 1,3; para is 1,4. For identical substituents, 1,5 can be renumbered 1,3.

tips.zh: 苯基C6H5—是取代基，不是芳香烃通式；横线表示连接。
tips.en: The phenyl group C6H5– is a substituent, not a general formula for arenes; the dash is an attachment bond.

tips.zh: 3D单双键画法是凯库勒示意；实际苯环的碳—碳键等价且电子离域。二维圆圈式强调离域。
tips.en: The 3D alternating bonds are a Kekulé representation. Benzene has equivalent carbon–carbon bonds and delocalized electrons; the 2D circle emphasizes this.

summary.zh: 识别卤素、羟基与醚氧，并从正确的一端编号。
summary.en: Identify halogens, hydroxyl groups and ether oxygen; number from the correct end.

tips.zh: alkyl halide是卤代烷R—X；acyl halide是酰卤R—C(=O)—X，多了羰基。
tips.en: An alkyl halide is R–X; an acyl halide is R–C(=O)–X and contains a carbonyl group.

tips.zh: 醇的羟基连在饱和碳上；醚的氧两侧连碳，且这里没有酯的羰基。
tips.en: An alcohol has hydroxyl attached to saturated carbon; an ether oxygen joins carbons without the adjacent carbonyl of an ester.

summary.zh: 看C=O旁连什么，再区分醛、酮、酸、酯、酰氯和酰胺。
summary.en: Inspect the neighbors of C=O to distinguish aldehydes, ketones, acids, esters, acyl chlorides and amides.

tips.zh: 羰基碳也计入母体碳数；甲醛、甲酸和甲酰胺都各有一个碳。
tips.en: The carbonyl carbon counts in the parent: methanal, methanoic acid and methanamide each contain one carbon.

tips.zh: 酯先分两边：英文先说醇侧烃基，再说酸侧；中文是某酸某酯。
tips.en: Split an ester into two parts. English names the alcohol-derived alkyl group before the acid-derived alkanoate; Chinese uses the opposite order.

tips.zh: 酯不是醚，酰胺不是胺；甲酸虽然羰基连氢，仍按完整羧基分类为羧酸。
tips.en: An ester is not an ether, and an amide is not an amine. Methanoic acid is classified by its complete carboxyl group, not as an aldehyde.

summary.zh: 区分氨基、酰胺与腈基，特别注意腈基里的碳。
summary.en: Distinguish amino, amide and nitrile groups, counting the nitrile carbon correctly.

tips.zh: 胺的氮不直接连羰基碳；酰胺的氮直接连羰基碳。
tips.en: An amine nitrogen is not directly attached to a carbonyl carbon; an amide nitrogen is.

tips.zh: CH3CH2CN里不仅有乙基的两个碳，还要数上CN的一个碳。
tips.en: CH3CH2CN contains two ethyl carbons plus the carbon of CN, giving three carbons in total.

text.zh: 碳连四个氢，四个方向指向四面体顶点，理想键角约109.5°。
text.en: The carbon bonds to four hydrogens toward tetrahedral corners, with an ideal angle of about 109.5 degrees.

text.zh: 只有一个碳，选用词根meth，对应中文“甲”。氢不计入碳数。
text.en: There is one carbon, so choose meth, corresponding to Chinese jia. Hydrogens do not add to the carbon count.

text.zh: 分子只有单键，属于烷烃：meth加ane，得到methane，甲烷。
text.en: Only single bonds are present. The alkane suffix ane combines with meth to give methane, or jiawan in Chinese.

prompt.zh: 甲烷中H—C—H的理想键角约是多少？
prompt.en: What is the ideal H–C–H bond angle in methane?

text.en: About 90 degrees
About 109.5 degrees
About 120 degrees
About 180 degrees

explanation.zh: 四个键方向构成四面体，理想角约109.5°，不是平面十字形。
explanation.en: Four bonding directions form a tetrahedral arrangement, about 109.5 degrees, not a flat cross.

note.zh: 这是甲烷的计算代表构象。球和棍是可视化符号，原子不是硬球。
note.en: This is a calculated representative geometry of methane. Balls and sticks are visual symbols, not literal hard atoms.

text.zh: 每个碳周围有四个成键方向，局部近似四面体；整个乙烷分子不是一个四面体。
text.en: Each carbon has four local bonding directions. Its local geometry is tetrahedral; the whole ethane molecule is not one tetrahedron.

text.zh: 主链两个碳，用eth；两个碳之间为单键，用烷烃词尾ane。
text.en: The parent chain contains two carbons, giving eth. The carbon–carbon single bond belongs to an alkane, using ane.

text.zh: C2H6叫ethane，乙烷。ethene是有双键的C2H4，不能把二者混写。
text.en: C2H6 is ethane. Ethene instead has formula C2H4 and a carbon–carbon double bond; these are different compounds.

prompt.zh: 原表把C2H6写成ethene，应改为哪个名称？
prompt.en: The worksheet calls C2H6 ethene. Which name corrects the error?

text.en: methane
ethene
ethane
ethyne

explanation.zh: 两碳、碳间单键、C2H6对应乙烷ethane。
explanation.en: Two carbons joined by a single bond, with formula C2H6, identify ethane.

note.zh: 单键可有不同扭转构象；此处为一种计算代表构象，不是固定不动的唯一形状。
note.en: Rotation about the single bond gives different conformations. This is one calculated representative, not the only frozen shape.

text.zh: 从一个末端沿连续碳链走到另一个末端，可依次经过三个碳。
text.en: Follow the continuous chain from one end to the other. It contains three carbon atoms without a branch.

text.zh: 三个碳用prop；碳之间都是单键，属于饱和烷烃，用ane。
text.en: Three carbons give the root prop. All carbon–carbon bonds are single, so the alkane suffix is ane.

title.zh: 名称不由画图角度决定
title.en: The drawing angle does not change the name

text.zh: prop加ane得到propane，丙烷。三维链弯折也仍然是同一条三碳链。
text.en: Combining prop and ane gives propane. Bending or rotating the 3D view does not change the three-carbon connectivity.

prompt.zh: 丙烷主链的词根是什么？
prompt.en: Which root describes the parent chain in propane?

text.en: meth, one carbon
eth, two carbons
prop, three carbons
but, four carbons

explanation.zh: 丙烷连续主链有三个碳，所以词根为prop。
explanation.en: Propane has three carbons in its continuous parent chain, so its root is prop.

note.zh: 模型为计算代表构象。骨架画法里的转角不等于额外的支链。
note.en: The model is a calculated representative conformer. A bend in the skeletal drawing is not an extra branch.

text.zh: 虽然总共有五个碳，但不重复经过碳时，最长连续路径只能经过三个碳。
text.en: There are five carbons in total, but the longest path without revisiting a carbon contains only three carbons.

text.zh: 剩下两个末端碳各是一个甲基，都连在主链第二个碳上，位置为2,2。
text.en: The two remaining terminal carbons are methyl groups. Both attach to parent carbon 2, giving locants 2,2.

text.zh: 2,2表示位置，di表示两个，methyl是甲基，propane是三碳母体。
text.en: The name 2,2-dimethylpropane combines locants 2,2, the multiplier di, methyl substituents and the propane parent.

prompt.zh: 这里母体为什么是丙烷而不是戊烷？
prompt.en: Why is the parent propane rather than pentane?

text.zh: 最长连续链只有三个碳
text.en: The longest continuous chain has three carbons
The whole molecule has only three carbons
The parent must be drawn as a straight line
The two methyl groups contain no carbon

explanation.zh: 主链按最长连续路径选择，不按全分子的五个碳直接命名。
explanation.en: Choose the longest continuous carbon path, not the total count of five carbons in the molecule.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。中心碳已经与四个碳成键，所以中心碳不带氢。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. The central carbon has four carbon bonds and therefore no attached hydrogen.

text.zh: 蓝色路径连续经过五个碳，主链用pentane。全分子七个碳不代表主链是庚烷。
text.en: The blue path contains five consecutive carbons, giving pentane. Seven total carbons do not make the parent heptane.

text.zh: 两个甲基分别连在2号和4号碳。两端编号都得到2,4，是对称的情况。
text.en: The methyl branches attach at carbons 2 and 4. Numbering this symmetric chain from either end gives 2,4.

text.zh: 两个相同甲基用dimethyl，把位置放前面，得到2,4-dimethylpentane。
text.en: Two identical methyl groups use dimethyl. Add their locants to obtain the name 2,4-dimethylpentane.

prompt.zh: 这个分子的主链碳数与总碳数分别是多少？
prompt.en: What are its parent-chain and total carbon counts?

text.en: Seven in the parent, seven in total
Five in the parent, seven in total
Five in the parent, five in total
Three in the parent, seven in total

explanation.zh: 主链五个碳，加上两条各含一个碳的甲基支链，总共七个碳。
explanation.en: The five-carbon parent plus two one-carbon methyl branches gives seven carbons altogether.

note.zh: 三维模型只是一个计算代表构象。转动单键不会改变2,4的连接位置。
note.en: This is one calculated representative conformer. Single-bond rotations do not change the substituent connectivity at 2 and 4.

text.zh: 每个双键碳有三个成键方向，局部近似平面三角形，理想角约120°。
text.en: Each double-bond carbon has three bonding directions in an approximately trigonal plane, with an ideal angle near 120 degrees.

text.zh: 两个碳之间是C=C而不是单键，属于烯烃。主链两个碳，词根eth。
text.en: The two carbons are connected by C=C rather than a single bond. This is an alkene with the two-carbon root eth.

text.zh: eth加ene得到ethene，乙烯。分子式C2H4，与乙烷C2H6不同。
text.en: Combine eth with the suffix ene to obtain ethene. Its formula C2H4 distinguishes it from ethane, C2H6.

prompt.zh: 乙烯中一个双键碳的局部几何是什么？
prompt.en: What is the local geometry at a double-bond carbon in ethene?

text.en: Trigonal planar
Tetrahedral
Linear
Square planar

explanation.zh: 双键作为一个方向，加上两个C—H方向，共三个方向，近似平面三角形。
explanation.en: The double bond counts as one direction; with two C–H directions, the local geometry is trigonal planar.

note.zh: 这是计算代表结构。理想120°与模型中具体H—C—C角可能略有不同。
note.en: This is a calculated representative structure. A particular H–C–C angle may differ slightly from the ideal 120 degrees.

text.zh: 每个三键碳只有两个成键方向：连氢和连另一个碳，两方向夹角约180°。
text.en: Each triple-bond carbon has two bonding directions, toward hydrogen and the other carbon, giving a linear angle near 180 degrees.

title.en: Two carbons and one triple bond

text.zh: 主链有两个碳，词根eth；碳间三键决定这是炔烃。
text.en: The parent has two carbons, giving eth. The carbon–carbon triple bond identifies the compound as an alkyne.

text.zh: eth加yne得到ethyne，乙炔。三键已经占三个键级，每个碳只再连一个氢。
text.en: The suffix yne gives ethyne. A triple bond uses three bond orders, leaving each carbon bonded to only one hydrogen.

prompt.zh: 炔烃英文命名常用哪个词尾？
prompt.en: Which suffix is used for an alkyne?

text.en: ane for an alkane
ene for an alkene
yne for an alkyne
ol for an alcohol

explanation.zh: 识别C≡C，使用yne；乙炔是ethyne。
explanation.en: A C≡C triple bond calls for yne; the two-carbon example is ethyne.

note.zh: 该计算代表结构为直线形；旋转视角可能使三根键的投影重叠，可转动查看。
note.en: This calculated representative structure is linear. The three bond strokes can overlap in projection; rotate the view to inspect them.

text.zh: 主链必须包含双键，共四个碳，所以母体词根为but。
text.en: The parent chain must include the double bond. Its four carbon atoms give the root but.

text.zh: 双键连接2号和3号碳，取较小的2，基本名称为but-2-ene。
text.en: The double bond connects carbons 2 and 3. Use the lower locant 2 to obtain but-2-ene.

text.zh: 这个模型的两个甲基在双键两侧相对，属于E构型，也称反式。
text.en: In this model the two methyl groups lie on opposite sides of the double bond, giving E or trans stereochemistry.

prompt.zh: 双键在2号与3号碳之间，名称里写哪个位置？
prompt.en: Which locant names a double bond between carbons 2 and 3?

text.en: Use locant one
Use locant two
Use locant three
Use locant five

explanation.zh: 多重键位置用所连两个碳里较小的编号，所以是2。
explanation.en: The multiple-bond locant is the smaller of its two carbon numbers, so it is 2.

note.zh: 原讲义未指定立体构型。本模型单独标出E异构体的代表构象；E与Z不是靠普通单键旋转互换的构象。
note.en: The worksheet did not specify stereochemistry. This is a representative conformer of the E stereoisomer; E and Z are not interconverted by ordinary single-bond rotation.

There is no double bond

The parent has only one carbon

A triple bond cannot be terminal

explanation.zh: 选择编号方向，使三键的较小端编号尽可能小，此处为1。
explanation.en: Choose the direction that gives the smaller endpoint of the triple bond the lowest locant, here 1.

text.en: Two NO2 substituents attach through nitrogen atoms to the benzene ring, requiring the prefix dinitro.

text.zh: 两个取代位置之间隔一个环碳，最小编号是1,3，不写较大的1,5。
text.en: One ring carbon separates the attachment sites. Choose the lower locants 1,3 rather than the alternative 1,5.
The locants 1,3 correspond to meta substitution, giving the full name 1,3-dinitrobenzene.

prompt.zh: 为什么选1,3而不选1,5？
prompt.en: Why choose 1,3 rather than 1,5 for these identical groups?

text.en: Because carbon five does not exist
Because nitro can attach only at position three

text.zh: 反向编号得到较小位置数
text.en: Reversing the numbering gives lower locants
Because the molecule has only three carbons

explanation.zh: 相同两个取代基可以选择编号方向，使位置数为较小的1,3。
explanation.en: For two identical substituents, choose the numbering direction that produces the smaller locants 1,3.

text.en: Replace the final e of ethane with ol to obtain ethanol. The single distinct hydroxyl position usually needs no locant.

text.zh: methoxy放在ethane前，得到methoxyethane，甲氧基乙烷，而不是丙醇。
text.en: Place methoxy before ethane to obtain methoxyethane, an ether rather than a propanol.

Two carbons
Three carbons
Four carbons

explanation.en: The ethane parent has two carbons. The remaining carbon belongs to the methoxy substituent.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。全分子三个碳，但醚的烷氧基命名不能把氧当成碳链的一环。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. It has three carbons overall, but alkoxyalkane naming does not count oxygen as part of a carbon chain.

text.en: Carbon forms a double bond to oxygen and is attached to hydrogen on both remaining sides, making the simplest aldehyde.

text.zh: 虽然没有CH3，分子仍有羰基里的一个碳，词根为meth。
text.en: Even without a CH3 group, the carbonyl supplies one carbon atom, so the correct root is meth.

text.zh: methane去e加al得到methanal，甲醛；不是methanol甲醇。
text.en: Replace the final e of methane with al to obtain methanal, not the alcohol methanol.

prompt.en: How many parent carbons does methanal contain?

text.en: Zero carbons
One carbon
Two carbons
Three carbons

explanation.zh: 羰基C=O中的C必须计入，甲醛总共有一个碳。
explanation.en: The carbon of C=O must be counted; methanal contains one carbon atom.

note.zh: 这是计算代表结构。甲醛中的al与甲醇中的ol只差一个字母，却是不同官能团。
note.en: This is a calculated representative structure. The endings al and ol differ by one letter but name different functional groups.

text.en: The terminal carbon is double-bonded to oxygen and directly bonded to hydrogen; this CHO group identifies an aldehyde.

title.en: Count the CH3 and CHO carbons

text.zh: 甲基里一个碳，加醛基里一个碳，总共两个碳，用eth。醛基碳编号1。
text.en: One methyl carbon plus one aldehyde carbon gives two carbons and the root eth. The aldehyde carbon is carbon 1.

text.zh: eth加醛的词尾al组成ethanal；不能漏掉醛基碳而称methanal。
text.en: The eth root with the aldehyde ending al gives ethanal. Omitting the aldehyde carbon would incorrectly give methanal.

prompt.en: How many carbons are in CH3CHO?

text.en: One, counting only CH3
Two, including the CHO carbon
Three, counting oxygen as one
Four, treating the 3 as a carbon count

explanation.zh: CH3的3是氢数，不是碳数；CH3和CHO各有一个碳。
explanation.en: The 3 in CH3 counts hydrogens, not carbons. CH3 and CHO each contain one carbon.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。醛基碳附近近似平面，但整个分子不因此只有一种空间构象。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. The aldehyde carbon is locally planar, without implying only one whole-molecule conformation.

text.zh: 羰基碳两侧都连甲基碳，没有直接连氢，因此该官能团是酮。
text.en: The carbonyl carbon is bonded to methyl carbons on both sides and not directly to hydrogen, identifying a ketone.

title.en: Include carbonyl in the three-carbon chain

text.zh: 左甲基、羰基、右甲基共三个碳，羰基在2号碳，母体为propan。
text.en: The left methyl, carbonyl and right methyl supply three carbons; the carbonyl is carbon 2 in the propan parent.

text.zh: 使用one得到propanone，丙酮。三碳酮的羰基只能在中间，常省略2。
text.en: The ketone suffix one gives propanone. A three-carbon ketone can only have the carbonyl in the middle, so 2 is commonly omitted.

prompt.zh: 丙酮为什么不是醛？
prompt.en: Why is propanone a ketone rather than an aldehyde?

text.en: Because it has no oxygen
Because it has no carbon–oxygen double bond

text.zh: 因为羰基碳两侧都连碳
text.en: Because its carbonyl carbon is bonded to carbon on both sides
Because it contains no hydrogens

explanation.zh: 区分醛酮看羰基碳的连接：丙酮的羰基碳连两个碳。
explanation.en: Inspect the carbonyl carbon: in propanone it is bonded to two carbon atoms, the defining ketone pattern.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。CO简写在此表示C(=O)，并不是C—O单键。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. CO in this condensed formula means C(=O), not a C–O single bond.

text.zh: 同一个碳连氧双键和OH，这一整体是羧基，不能拆开误叫醛或醇。
text.en: One carbon bears both a double-bonded oxygen and OH. This complete carboxyl group must not be misclassified as an aldehyde or alcohol.

text.zh: 甲酸没有额外的烷基碳，但羧基里有一个碳，所以碳根为meth。
text.en: Methanoic acid has no additional alkyl carbon, but its carboxyl group contains one carbon, giving meth.

title.en: Use oic acid for the carboxylic acid

text.zh: 一碳的羧酸写methanoic acid，中文甲酸，常用英文名formic acid。
text.en: The one-carbon carboxylic acid is methanoic acid, commonly called formic acid, using the ending oic acid.

prompt.zh: 甲酸应按哪个完整官能团分类？
prompt.en: Which complete functional group determines the class of methanoic acid?

text.en: Carboxyl group COOH
Ether group C–O–C
Amino group NH2
Nitrile group C≡N

explanation.zh: 羰基碳连OH构成完整羧基，所以甲酸属于羧酸。
explanation.en: OH attached to the carbonyl carbon forms a carboxyl group, so methanoic acid is a carboxylic acid.

note.zh: 这是计算代表结构。甲酸羰基碳虽连氢，也不能把完整羧基忽略而称作醛。
note.en: This is a calculated representative structure. Although its carbonyl carbon also bears hydrogen, the complete carboxyl group makes it an acid, not an aldehyde.

text.zh: NH2直接连饱和碳，附近没有C=O相连，因此属于胺，不是酰胺。
text.en: NH2 attaches to saturated carbon without an adjacent C=O bond, making this an amine rather than an amide.

text.zh: 主链两个碳用ethan，氨基所连碳为1号，两端等价时不必重复标1。
text.en: The two-carbon chain gives ethan, with the amino-bearing carbon assigned number 1; the single distinct position need not be repeated.

text.zh: 系统名ethanamine采用amine词尾；常用名ethylamine是乙基加胺，均指乙胺。
text.en: The systematic name ethanamine uses the suffix amine. The common name ethylamine combines ethyl and amine for the same molecule.

prompt.zh: 乙胺与乙酰胺的区别是什么？
prompt.en: What distinguishes ethanamine from ethanamide?

text.zh: 乙胺的氮不直接连羰基碳
text.en: Its nitrogen is not directly attached to carbonyl carbon
Ethanamine contains no nitrogen
Ethanamine has one additional oxygen

text.zh: 二者只是不同英文拼写
text.en: They are merely alternative English spellings

explanation.zh: 乙胺为CH3CH2NH2，没有羰基；乙酰胺为CH3C(=O)NH2。
explanation.en: Ethanamine is CH3CH2NH2 without a carbonyl, whereas ethanamide is CH3C(=O)NH2.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。普通胺氮近似三角锥，氮的孤对电子未以原子球表示。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. Ordinary amine nitrogen is approximately pyramidal; its lone pair is not shown as an atom sphere.

text.zh: 三键的一端是氮N，因此属于腈基，而不是碳碳三键的炔烃。
text.en: One end of the triple bond is nitrogen, so this is a nitrile group rather than the C≡C group of an alkyne.

text.zh: 乙基部分两个碳，加腈基中的一个碳，共三个碳；腈基碳编号1。
text.en: The two ethyl carbons plus the nitrile carbon make three parent carbons. The nitrile carbon receives locant 1.

title.en: Add nitrile to the parent name

text.zh: 三碳母体为propane，加nitrile得到propanenitrile，丙腈，不是乙腈。
text.en: The three-carbon parent propane takes the ending nitrile to give propanenitrile, not the two-carbon ethanenitrile.

prompt.zh: CH3CH2CN为什么叫丙腈而不是乙腈？
prompt.en: Why is CH3CH2CN propanenitrile rather than ethanenitrile?

text.en: Nitrogen counts as a carbon
The carbon in CN is included in the parent chain
A triple bond represents three carbons
All nitriles are called propanenitrile

explanation.zh: CH3、CH2和CN各贡献一个碳，总共三个碳，编号从腈基碳开始。
explanation.en: CH3, CH2 and CN each contribute one carbon, giving three in total, numbered from the nitrile carbon.

note.zh: 这是计算代表构象。腈基碳与氮附近近似直线；氮原子不计入碳数。
note.en: This is a calculated representative conformer. The nitrile carbon–nitrogen region is linear, and nitrogen is not counted as carbon.
